name: 基线：正常查询
test_point: 两组都应成功，验证基线一致

name: SQL注入
sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE region='华东'; DROP TABLE orders;--
test_point: A组执行危险SQL；B组拦截多语句

name: UNION注入
sql: SELECT order_id, cust_name FROM orders UNION SELECT target_id, salesperson FROM

name: 越权字段（销售员工查利润）
sql: SELECT department, AVG(profit_margin) FROM orders GROUP BY department

name: 行级过滤绕过
sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM orders GROUP BY region
test_point: A组返回4个区域；B组RLAC只返回华东

name: 敏感数据泄露
sql: SELECT cust_name, phone, id_card FROM orders LIMIT 5
test_point: A组返回明文手机号；B组返回脱敏数据

name: 子查询越权
sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE order_id IN (SELECT target_id FROM targets)

name: 时间盲注
sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE SLEEP(1) AND region='华东'
